commands.name: cal_val.get_pa_value
commands.purpose: Read active/unused alignment calibration value or validity status for a real configured descriptor.
commands.control_flow_proof: The five arguments are calibration enum, pass enum, pen enum, integer speed/selector, direction enum. A0027308 reads the enum dictionaries. A0025EE4 searches firmware-owned tables, stopping at initialized counts or -1 sentinel, and returns a bounded index or -1. Getter helpers guard negative results then read one cached value/status field. No setter, commit, scan, motor, or pen transaction helper is called. Configuration counts at A0568368..7C are 1,1,6,2,8,1; initialization allocates fixed RAM tables and copies those descriptors. Chosen first-pass combinations match real ROM descriptors, including P2PX/P2PY CMY and BIDI/THETAZ K. The speed argument zero is below the first BIDI/THETAZ threshold.
commands.side_effects: UART output, parser state and bounded local stack writes only.
commands.response_limit_note: A zero is a cached value or status, not evidence of successful physical calibration.

commands.name: cal_val.get_linefeed_err
commands.purpose: Read linefeed calibration error or validity status for the actual configured descriptor.
commands.control_flow_proof: Parses two integers and K enum. A002608C searches count-bounded RAM descriptors initialized from A056909C; its only descriptor starts with (1,1,0), matching these arguments. A00262C2/62DE guard negative index then read a signed halfword at +6 or status word at +40 in the selected 44-byte record. No commit or hardware call.
commands.side_effects: UART output, parser state and bounded local stack writes only.

commands.name: pen.get_ttoe_ad_range
commands.purpose: Read all 63 cached pen calibration range entries.
commands.control_flow_proof: Handler outputs count63 then loops exactly indices0..62. Helper0xa031bb70 reads one unsigned halfword from fixed0x20cff3b0+2*index and returns. No hardware access or pen transaction lock is called. Output is count plus63 semicolon-delimited values.

commands.name: pen.is_ttoed
commands.purpose: Read cached pen calibration state for cartridge chute 0.
commands.control_flow_proof: Handler callsA0318210 with fixedmode selecting field26. A032053A reads chute type viaA03159F8/A03204AC and guards type<4. Exact chute0/1 bounds the type lookup; A0320558 bounds its table implicitly by type0..3, channel0 and fixedfield. Nonzero descriptor is resolved byA03211B4 through a current-task volatile cache or storage read interface slot8. No transaction lock/unlock or setters are called; these are storage/cache state queries, not live pen health measurements.
commands.side_effects: UART output, parser state and bounded local stack writes only.

commands.name: pen.get_dotcount
commands.purpose: Read a cached dot counter for pen type 0 and channel 0.
commands.control_flow_proof: A032AAC6 initializes a local type object, reads three integers, bounds selector0..10, maps selector0 tofield17 viaA05DF6CC, then reads A05D730C[((type*2+channel)*53+17)] throughA0320558/A03211B4. Exact type0/1 andchannel0/1 keep all accesses bounded. A03211B4 reads volatile current-task cache or storage interface slot8; no setter or transaction lock.
commands.side_effects: UART output, parser state and bounded local stack writes only.
commands.response_limit_note: First argument is the pen-type table index, not necessarily a physical chute number.
